scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check on the status of my application. Could you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The loan product you were approved for is a USDA Rural Housing Service (RHS) or Farm Service Agency (FSA) first lien loan.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Could you please tell me the interest rate and the total costs associated with this loan? Also, is there any indication of high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 6.874%. The total loan costs are $5,908.00. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what is my debt-to-income ratio?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been sold to Ginnie Mae. The debt-to-income ratio is not present in your loan record.

dialogue.user: Got it. Thank you for the information. I think that covers everything I needed to know. <Satisfied> The agent was helpful and provided clear answers to my questions, which helped me understand the status and details of my loan application.
